title: Panta Rhei (Read-Only)
summary: A live render loop tries to advance a Futurist composition sixty times a second; a recursive Object.freeze rejects every change and prints the runtime's own refusal as the wall label.
mechanism: Deep Object.freeze plus a strict-mode requestAnimationFrame loop whose per-frame mutation attempts throw TypeErrors, caught and displayed live while a frame counter proves time passes and the pixels do not.
references: Heraclitus (panta rhei) and Parmenides (being vs becoming)
y-a-v-a manifesto ('There is no art piece, only change')
